title: Private and modern family style home on 1 acre lot
description:
This one level home is spacious with a modern flare.  We are North of Nashville and 15 to 20 minutes from downtown Nashville (taking I65 South to Ellington Pkwy). You will feel right at home and ready to wind down and relax once inside. Private parking and patio with plenty of distance from the neighbors. The pool is an added plus with a spacious patio to lounge on. Home sweet home away from home.

The space
Marble and wood floors are the highlight of this home that gives the modern flare. You are ten minutes from the grocery store and Rivergate mall. The interstate is only minutes away to get you to downtown Nashville

Guest access
Guest will have access to all amenities while staying on the property.

Other things to note
Pool Warning: If you have small children or if you do not know how to swim, please be aware that you do this at your own risk. We encourage parents to stay with small children when utilizing the pool.
